description: A group of 15 close friends who met at Lakeview University and have maintained a group chat since graduating 6-7 years ago. They now live in different cities and use the chat to stay connected, plan occasional meetups, celebrate milestones, and share life updates. Interactions range from casual banter to deeper support during hard moments.
